data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kristo total 29, reducing to 2. Number 2 is associated with cooperation, sensitivity and balance.

in_hebrew.name: כריסטו
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew word 'Masah' meaning to anoint. The Greek form 'Christos' is derived from this name.

in_greek.name: Χριστός
in_greek.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'Christos' meaning anointed. The Hebrew root 'Masah' is the source of this name.

in_latin.name: Christus
in_latin.long_meaning: From the Latin word 'Christus', derived from the Greek 'Christos'. The Hebrew root 'Masah' is the origin of this name.
